newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent gains on technical buying, waits for API.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent gains on technical buying, waits for API.

text.p: IPE front month Brent futures gained about ten cents after the NYMEX opened on Wednesday on a technical push in a quiet market, brokers said.
At 1540 GMT April Brent was trading at $20.70 a barrel, up 31 cents.
"It's broken yesterday's high of $20.62 so that given it a push, but basically we're seeing consolidation," said a broker.
Direction for Brent's move up also came from April WTI breaking through $22.47 to stand at $22.72.
Attention was focused on weekly American Petroleum Institute (API) stocks data, expected after the market closes.
Brokers expected the APIs to show build in crude stocks of up to four million barrels.
"If the market goes much higher we will be wanting to sell," said one trader who said the market was fundamantally bearish.
Further resistance was put at $22.85 and then $22.96.
Others said Brent was likely to stay range-trading since liquidity has been reduced due to Institue of Petroluem week functions in London.
March gas oil gained $2.25 a tonne to stand at $177.25. Dealers said mild weather in Europe tempered interest.
